note: Unofficial English renderings of the Chinese strings in requirements.json, keyed by the Chinese text. The Chinese text is what the official sources say.

strings.表單寫「114 年前適用／115 年後適用」並註明「以入學年度標準為主」；這裡解: The form says “applies up to 114 / from 115” and notes that the standard of your admission year applies. This is read here as admitted in academic year 114 or earlier versus 115 or later; confirm with the Language Center before applying.
strings.英文能力鑑定細則（114-06-18 核備）對資電學院仍列舊標準（例如多益 60: The English proficiency rules (approved 2025-06-18) still list the old standard for this college (for example TOEIC 600). The new figures such as 785 come from the Language Center form and chart in force from academic year 115, as a college-set standard under art. 3(2) of the rules.
strings.托福網路測驗：細則寫 72 分（舊制），語言中心圖表與表單寫新制 3.5 級。: TOEFL iBT: the rules say 72 (old scale); the Language Center chart and form say level 3.5 on the new scale.
strings.「校學士」是語言中心表單上的欄位名稱，官方頁面沒有進一步定義適用的班別。: “校學士” is the column name on the Language Center form; the official pages do not define which programs it covers.
strings.英文另接受 EnglishScore（聽讀測驗）: For English, EnglishScore (Listening & Reading) is also accepted
strings.工學院表單只列出可採計的檢定名稱；第二外語與 EnglishScore 的合格分: The College of Engineering form lists only the names of accepted tests. Passing scores for second foreign languages and EnglishScore are not on the form; ask the College of Engineering office.
strings.英文另接受 English Score: For English, English Score is also accepted
strings.理學院表單只列出可採計的檢定名稱；第二外語與 English Score 的合格: The College of Science form lists only the names of accepted tests. Passing scores for second foreign languages and English Score are not on the form; ask the College of Science office.
strings.語言中心圖表註 (1)：英文系學生不適用上述門檻。: Language Center chart, note (1): students of the English Department are not subject to these thresholds.
strings.細則第 3 條第 1 款：英美語文學系畢業生認定為通過英文能力鑑定。: Rules art. 3(1): graduates of the Department of English are deemed to have passed the English proficiency requirement.
strings.未達標者可憑取得入學資格後參加英檢的成績證明，修習一學期工學院碩士班進修英文課程: Students below the score may, with a score report from an English test taken after admission, take one semester of the college's Remedial English for Master's Program course; a grade of 70 or above counts as passing.
strings.學院標準本身沒有外籍生條款；第 5 條允許特殊情形由各系所專案處理。各系的修業辦: The college standard itself has no clause on international students; art. 5 lets departments handle special cases individually. A department's own rules may say more (Mechanical Engineering, for example, explicitly exempts international degree students).
strings.修業辦法第 5 條：「申請學位考試前應滿足『國立中央大學工學院碩士班學生英文能力: Department rules, art. 5: “The College of Engineering English proficiency standard for master's students must be met before applying for the degree examination. International degree students are not subject to this article.”
strings.「外籍生除上述規定外，畢業前應至本校語言中心至少選修兩門華語課程或通過華語能力: “In addition, international students must, before graduating, take at least two Chinese courses at the NCU Language Center or pass TOCFL Band A (Novice).”
strings.修業辦法沒有寫外籍生可免除英文標準。: The department rules do not say international students are exempt from the English standard.
strings.表列分數是免修門檻；沒有達到的人修完一學年進修英文課程即可。: The listed scores are waiver thresholds; students who do not reach them simply complete the one-year Remedial English course.
strings.各系所如自訂更嚴格的標準，從其規定。: Where a department sets a stricter standard, the department's standard applies.
strings.辦法沒有外籍生條款，只排除國際經營管理碩士學位學程（IMBA）的研究生；特殊情形: The rule has no clause on international students; it only excludes students of the International MBA (IMBA). Special cases may be handled individually by each department.
strings.B2 對照分數依管理學院公告，會隨公告調整（對照表 2026-02-09 更新）: The B2 score equivalents follow the College of Management's announcement and change with it (table updated 2026-02-09).
strings.適用入學年度依管理學院規章頁的版本標示；送件前請向系所確認適用版本。: The admission years follow the version labels on the College of Management regulations page; confirm which version applies to you with your department.
strings.條文把兩項並列，沒有寫「擇一」；兩項是否都要滿足請向所辦確認。: The article lists the two items side by side without saying “either”; ask the institute office whether both must be met.
strings.條文另列托福 CBT 220 分與其他替代方式，詳見原文。: The article also lists TOEFL CBT 220 and other alternatives; see the original text.
strings.多益 730 分以上未達 750 分者，學位考試前在符合條件的國際學術會議以英文: Students with TOEIC 730–749 who present a paper in English at a qualifying international conference before the degree examination are treated as meeting the English requirement.
strings.其他測驗的對應分數列在原文的對照表；該表的文字層排版錯亂，請直接看原文 PDF。: Equivalent scores for other tests are in a table in the original document; its text layer is scrambled, so read the original PDF.
strings.在學期間考過英檢未通過，但達到多益 550、托福 ITP 460、托福 iBT: Students who took an English test during their studies without passing, but reached TOEIC 550, TOEFL ITP 460, TOEFL iBT 42, IELTS 4.0, GEPT Intermediate (listening and reading) or BESTEP listening and reading 150, may take the Language Center's Academic English Writing (LN4901) or the Graduate Institute of Network Learning Technology's Academic English (NL7037); a grade of 75 or above meets the requirement. These credits do not count toward graduation.
strings.「如在入學前已取得下列標準之英文檢定考試證書者，母語是英語系國家的外籍生、及大學: “International students whose native language is that of an English-speaking country, and students who earned their bachelor's degree in an English-speaking country, who obtained an English test certificate at the standard below before admission may apply to the program committee; once approved, the English test is waived.”
strings.「課號 PHT 開頭之初級中文(I、II) (僅外籍生需要，如通過中央研究院國際: “Elementary Chinese (I, II), course numbers starting with PHT (required of international students only; waived for those who pass the Chinese test run by the Academia Sinica TIGP), 0 credits.”
strings.「外籍生、僑生及陸生非中文相關科系畢業者，經審查後得要求補修大學部課程學分。」: “International, overseas Chinese and mainland Chinese students who did not graduate from a Chinese-related department may, after review, be required to make up undergraduate course credits.”
strings.「外籍生須通過華語文能力測驗(TOCFL)中的聽力、閱讀、口語進階級考試」: “International students must pass the listening, reading and speaking tests of TOCFL at Band B (Advanced).”
strings.「學生應通過至少一項附表二之外國語言能力測驗(外籍生之所屬國家官方語言除外)。」: “Students must pass at least one foreign-language proficiency test in Appendix 2 (for international students, the official language of their own country does not count).”
strings.可採計的外語測驗完整清單在修業辦法附表二。取得的版本是 114-06-10 系院: The full list of accepted foreign-language tests is in Appendix 2 of the rules. The copy obtained is the version passed by the department and college on 2025-06-10; it is not confirmed as the final version approved by the Academic Affairs Committee.
strings.未達者得憑入學後參加英檢的成績證明，依學院「進修英文課程施行細則」修課。: Students below the score may, with a score report from an English test taken after admission, take courses under the college's Remedial English implementation rules.
strings.標準沒有外籍生條款；第 4 條允許特殊情形由各學程專案處理。: The standard has no clause on international students; art. 4 lets each program handle special cases individually.
strings.標準寫「本院學生」，沒有區分碩士與博士；這裡在兩個學制各列一筆。: The standard says “students of this college” without separating master's and PhD; it is listed here under both degrees.
strings.英檢合格者填寫所屬學院的審核申請表，並檢附成績單正本（檢核後歸還；影本或網路成績: Students who pass a test fill in their college's verification form and attach the original score report (returned after checking; photocopies and online scores are not accepted, though TOEFL, IELTS and Linguaskill may be shown as electronic score reports).
strings.資電、管理、生醫理工、客家學院學生到語言中心辦理；理學院、工學院學生洽院辦；地科: Students of the EECS, Management, Health Sciences and Technology, and Hakka colleges apply at the Language Center; Science and Engineering students apply at their college office; Earth Sciences and Liberal Arts students apply at their department office.
strings.成績單需印有中文姓名；只有英文姓名者需另附證件（表單寫：本國生附護照、外籍生附身: The score report must show your Chinese name. If it shows only an English name, bring an identity document as well (the form says: passport for local students, ID card for international students).
strings.審核需 7 個工作天，之後自行登入畢審系統查看結果。: Verification takes 7 working days; afterwards check the result yourself in the graduation review system.
strings.「大一英文免修」與「英文畢業門檻」是兩件不同的申請，需分開送件。: The Freshman English waiver and the English graduation threshold are two separate applications and must be filed separately.
strings.未通過英文能力鑑定的大學部學生，須選修一學年的「進修英文」（兩學期、共 4 學分: Undergraduates who have not passed the English proficiency requirement must take one academic year of Remedial English (進修英文; two semesters, 4 credits in total) and pass it in order to graduate.
strings.選修進修英文的前提是入學後參加過細則第 3 條所列的任一項英文鑑定考試；從未參加: You may take Remedial English only after sitting at least one of the English tests listed in art. 3 of the rules following admission; students who never sat one may not enrol. Students below the passing score can bring the original score report to the Language Center to add the course.
strings.第一次修進修英文前，須填「修課資格審核申請表」並附英檢成績單正本，到語言中心審核: Before taking Remedial English for the first time, fill in the eligibility review form, attach the original score report, and have it approved at the Language Center before selecting the course.
strings.進修英文學分是否列入畢業學分由各系規定：115 學年度應修科目表中，多數學系寫「: Whether Remedial English credits count toward graduation is set by each department: in the 115 curriculum sheets most departments say they do not count, while Computer Science and Information Engineering and the EECS college bachelor program say they do.
strings.可抵免進修英文的情形：修過英文系開設、學分數相同的進階英文課程且及格；或近四年內: Remedial English can be waived by: passing an advanced English course of the same credits offered by the English Department; or, within the last four years, passing a non-general-education English course of the same credits at another university, approved by the Language Center.
strings.身心障礙生得依個別情況專案處理，或免予鑑定。: Students with disabilities may be handled case by case or exempted from the requirement.
strings.學則、英文能力鑑定細則、語言中心頁面與各學院表單都沒有把外籍生排除在英文畢業門檻: Neither the Study Regulations, the English proficiency rules, the Language Center pages nor the college forms exclude international students from the English graduation threshold, and the Academic Affairs notice on degree certificates applies to all bachelor's students alike. On the official documents available, international bachelor's students must also meet the threshold or take Remedial English.
strings.沒有學測或指考成績的學生，只要入學後參加過一次細則所列的英文鑑定考試，就具備進修: Students without a GSAT or AST score (most international students) are eligible for Remedial English once they have sat one of the English tests listed in the rules after admission.
strings.理、工、地科、文學院可用第二外語達成門檻，可採計的語言含越南文、泰文、日文、韓文: The Science, Engineering, Earth Sciences and Liberal Arts colleges accept a second foreign language for the threshold, including Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, German, French and Spanish. The official documents do not say whether your native language can be used; ask your college or department.
strings.「英語系國家之外籍生：個案審理」「接受以英文為主要授課語言之高中教育滿三年者：個: “International students from English-speaking countries: reviewed case by case” and “students with three or more years of English-medium high school: reviewed case by case” are in the Freshman English waiver rules (Freshman Foreign Language rules, art. 7), not in the graduation threshold rules.
strings.成績單只有英文姓名時要另附證件（表單寫：本國生附護照、外籍生附身分證）。: If your score report shows only an English name, bring an identity document as well (the form says: passport for local students, ID card for international students).
strings.學則第 48 條第 2 款：學士班學生須「選修『進修英文』成績及格，或通過本校語: Study Regulations art. 48(2): to graduate, bachelor's students must pass Remedial English or pass an English proficiency test recognised by the Language Center; where a college sets its own foreign-language standard approved by the Academic Affairs Committee, that standard applies.
strings.英文能力鑑定暨進修英文課程實施細則第 3 條列出各學院的合格分數，並規定三種例外: Art. 3 of the English proficiency and Remedial English rules lists each college's passing scores and three exceptions: English Department graduates are deemed to have passed; colleges with their own standard follow it; students with disabilities may be handled case by case or exempted. There is no exception for international students.
strings.學則第 58 條：研究生的畢業條件由各系（所、專班、學位學程）自訂。學校層級沒有: Study Regulations art. 58: graduation conditions for graduate students are set by each department, institute or degree program. There is no university-level English or Chinese graduation threshold for graduate students.
strings.外國學生入學規定第 18 條：各系所應自訂中英文語言能力之入學標準；入學後，外國: Regulations for the Admission of International Students, art. 18: each department sets its own Chinese and English admission standards; after admission, international students take language tests as their department requires.
strings.明文讓外籍生免除英文門檻的只有兩處：機械系碩士班（外籍學位生不受限）與人工智慧國: Only two places explicitly exempt international students from the English threshold: the Mechanical Engineering master's program (international degree students are not subject to it) and the International Graduate Program in Artificial Intelligence (native English speakers, or holders of a degree from an English-speaking country, may apply for a waiver).
strings.對外籍生另加華語要求的有：環境工程研究所（兩門華語課或 TOCFL 入門級）、客: These add a Chinese requirement for international students: the Graduate Institute of Environmental Engineering (two Chinese courses or TOCFL Band A Novice), the PhD Program in Hakka Studies (TOCFL Band B Advanced) and the Physics TIGP-MST program (Elementary Chinese I and II).
strings.其餘查過的院系規定都沒有提到外籍生，只能透過院級規定的「特殊情形專案處理」條款個: The other college and department rules checked do not mention international students; the only route is a case-by-case request under a college rule's special-circumstances clause.
strings.資訊電機學院、理學院、地球科學學院、文學院沒有找到院級的研究所語言門檻。: No college-level graduate language threshold was found for the colleges of EECS, Science, Earth Sciences and Liberal Arts.
strings.查過系所修業辦法而沒有語言門檻的包括：資工（碩、博）、電機碩、通訊碩、化學（碩、: Department rules checked that contain no language threshold: Computer Science (master's, PhD), Electrical Engineering (master's), Communication Engineering (master's), Chemistry (master's, PhD), Astronomy, Atmospheric Sciences (master's, PhD), Geophysics (master's), Business Administration (PhD), Civil Engineering (master's, PhD), Life Sciences (master's, PhD), English (master's), Chinese Literature (PhD).
strings.下列系所的研究所規定還沒查：營建管理所、材料所、能源所、電機博、網路學習科技所、: Graduate rules of these departments have not been checked yet: Construction Management, Materials Science, Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering (PhD), Network Learning Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics (regular master's and PhD), Optics and Photonics (master's), Cognitive Neuroscience, Applied Geology, Hydrological and Oceanic Sciences, Space Science and Engineering, Economics, Industrial Management, Accounting, Industrial Economics, in-service programs, Philosophy, History, Art Studies, Learning and Instruction, Law and Government, Biomedical Sciences and Engineering, Systems Biology and Bioinformatics, Translational and Interdisciplinary Medicine.
strings.沒有列出的系所不代表沒有門檻，請以系所修業辦法為準；`/intl/program: A department that is not listed may still have a threshold; follow the department's own rules. `regulation_url` in `/intl/programs` links to each department's rules.
strings.大一國文修課實施辦法第 5 點：非中文系外籍生不需修中文系開設的大一國文，但須修: Freshman Chinese implementation rules, point 5: international students outside the Chinese Department do not take the department's Freshman Chinese; instead they must take 6 credits of Chinese language courses at the Language Center and complete the course-substitution procedure before graduating.
strings.同辦法第 5 點：中文系外籍生須參加中文能力分級測驗；初級組除修中文系大一國文外: Same rules, point 5: international students in the Chinese Department take a Chinese placement test; those placed at beginner level take the department's Freshman Chinese and also Language Center courses by level (not counted toward graduation credits) before they may take “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文).
strings.共同必修科目選修辦法第 3 條：僑生及外籍生修習「僑生國文」一學年 5 學分，不: Common Required Courses rules, art. 3: overseas Chinese and international students take “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文), 5 credits over one academic year, and need not take the Freshman Chinese writing course.
strings.僑生須參加中文能力分級測驗，修「僑生國文」一學年 5 學分；初級組須先修語言中心: Overseas Chinese students take a Chinese placement test and “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (5 credits over one academic year); those at beginner level first take Language Center courses (not counted toward graduation credits).
strings.上面兩份法規對非中文系外籍生的寫法不一致（華語課程 6 學分，或僑生國文 5 學: The two regulations above disagree for international students outside the Chinese Department (6 credits of Chinese language courses, or 5 credits of 僑生國文). Confirm the actual practice with the Office of Academic Affairs or the Chinese Department.
strings.研究所沒有學校層級的華語要求；各系所是否另有規定，要看系所的修業規定。: There is no university-level Chinese requirement for graduate students; whether a department has one depends on its own rules.
strings.外籍生獎助學金：申請時須有通過本校一門華語課程的成績及格證明，或華語文溝通能力證: NCU International Student Scholarship: applicants need a passing grade in one NCU Chinese course, or proof of Chinese communication ability (fall entrants are exempt when applying for the second semester of their first year). This is a condition for the scholarship, not for graduating; a Chinese course taken during a master's program does not carry over to a PhD.
strings.華語文能力測驗獎勵金：修過語言中心華語課程並通過 TOCFL 高階級（Level: TOCFL reward: students who took a Language Center Chinese course and pass TOCFL Level 4 or above may apply for a NT$2,000 reward.
strings.招生時的語言證明：全中文授課的系所要求相當於 CEFR A2 以上的中文能力證明: Language proof at admission: Chinese-taught programs ask for Chinese proficiency equivalent to CEFR A2 or above; programs taught in English, or with enough English courses to graduate, ask for English proficiency equivalent to CEFR B1 or above. Departments may set their own standards.
strings.113 學年度（含）以前入學適用聽讀測驗；分數未列在表單或語言中心圖表上: Admitted in 113 or earlier: the listening and reading test applies; its score is not on the form or the Language Center chart
strings.113 學年度（含）前入學適用聽讀測驗；語言中心圖表列聽讀總分 170: Admitted in 113 or earlier: the listening and reading test applies; the Language Center chart lists a listening and reading total of 170
strings.114 學年度起入學適用聽讀說寫測驗: Four-skill test, for students admitted from 114
strings.114 學年度（含）後入學適用聽說讀寫測驗: Four-skill test, for students admitted from 114
strings.3.5 級（語言中心圖表）；學院表單仍寫舊制 64 分: Level 3.5 (Language Center chart); the college form still says 64 on the old scale
strings.4 級（語言中心圖表）；學院表單仍寫舊制 72 分: Level 4 (Language Center chart); the college form still says 72 on the old scale
strings.64 分；2026-01-21 起的新制成績為 3.5 級: 64; level 3.5 on the new scale in use from 2026-01-21
strings.聽說讀寫總分 690，且聽力 85、閱讀 85、口說 260、寫作 260: Four-skill total 690, with listening 85, reading 85, speaking 260, writing 260
strings.聽說讀寫總分 700，且聽力 90、閱讀 90、口說 260、寫作 260: Four-skill total 700, with listening 90, reading 90, speaking 260, writing 260
strings.聽讀總分 170、說寫總分 510: Listening and reading total 170; speaking and writing total 510
strings.語言中心華語組每學期為國際學生、僑生與交換學生開設華語學分課程（每學期 18 週: Each semester the Language Center's Chinese division offers credit courses in Chinese for international, overseas Chinese and exchange students (18 weeks per semester).
